column2: Hunt yokai?
The Hell World?
My eyebrows are antennae for sniffing out yokai. Your bodies are giving off yokai energy!
Hold on!\n\n"Your bodies"... you mean not just me, but {p} too?
Yep.
(From me, who hijacked a Demon's body, sure. But yokai energy coming off {p} too? That's weird.)
Are we possessed by a yokai!?
Something weird must've happened. Tell me about it.
Actually...
Hmm. A black moon and a mansion floating on a pond, huh.
Huh? You don't seem very surprised.
Heh heh! Well, y'know...
This guy's fishy after all! He knows something...
Akira-kun...?
If you wanna go to that mansion, head back to the pond. See ya!
...He got away! To the pond, {p}!
...Could that e-mail have been from Enma-kun...?
Don't you find it strange?\n\nIt feels like it suddenly got dark...
Look, the moon's reflected on the water!
No doubt about it, it's {s}!
...Isn't it a trap?
You think so too?
Whoa!?
See that, Ryo?
Yes. That's no decoration. It's a real oni's head.
...Don't let your guard down, {p}!
You're okay...
The road got blocked off... I was worried about you! Akira-kun! You're all right too!
Akira-kun... You seem like a different person...
Got a problem with me changing?
You're better than before! All manly and wild! Swoon...
{s}, how did you get here?
Actually, Enma-kun rescued me.
So that's why he wasn't surprised by {p}'s story.
Oh, right, Enma-kun is waiting for you, {p}. Let's go!
{p}, we'll wait here. Go talk to Enma-kun.
No, that's not it. Enma-kun's yokai antennae, you see...
...reacted to me...
I'm glad you're safe, {p}.
Honey! Why would the yokai antennae pick up on you...?
Probably... because I'm not human...
Wh-what do you mean!?
...If we ever fight side by side, you'll understand.
After hearing your story, I've been thinking about the black moon.
You mean the black moon is linking different dimensions together?
...They've been stung by bees!
Just as I thought! It's the work of the yokai Beehive Nyudo, jaja! The bees Beehive Nyudo controls suck out people's brains!
So that's why the townspeople...
Turned into airheads, jaja!\n\nTheir brains get sucked out, their reason is stolen, and they act on instinct alone, jaja.
So that's why things got so hilarious around here!
Enma-kun! This is no laughing matter!
Nothin's funnier than people who've lost their reason!
This is no mere joke, Enma-kun.
Anyway, beat Beehive Nyudo and you're a real Yokai Patrol member!\n\nThen I'll take {p} to the Hell World!
Hot... bothered...
I'm starviiing! No matter how much I eat, it's not enough!
I'm so irritated, so irritated!
Look! Look at me! Am I pretty!?
So sleepyyy... Zzz... snooore...
I don't wanna work anymore.
Someone attacked by a yokai. I wonder if there are lots of others... We have to find Dokuro, quick!
Someone attacked by a yokai. I wonder if there are lots of others... We have to find Beehive Nyudo, quick!
Then where's Beehive Nyudo...?
What's that huge swarm of bees!?
Here comes the yokai Beehive Nyudo, jaja!
Beehive Nyudo! Go back to the Hell World quietly!
Not until I've collected every brain in the world... I won't go back to the Hell World! I'll suck out loads of fresh brains!
He's not listening one bit, Enma-kun...
Grr, you dare mock me!
That's {s}'s voice!
Let's carry her inside!
{s} is burning up!
A whole night's passed, and she won't wake up and the fever won't go down.
The black moon's still up in the sky, too.\n\nAnd it's long past dawn...
What's that!?
Let's go see!
A craft I've never seen before. A fighter plane? Where's the pilot?
Bet he's collapsed somewhere.
...Take a look at this.
It looks like a helmet.\n\nThen is the person who was flying it somewhere nearby?
Let's look around!
{!R}This is Saotome! Answer if you can hear me! {!R}Ryo! Respond!
Um, hello?
{!R}Oh! Ryo, you're safe! {!R}No... the voice is different? Who are you! Where's Ryo!
My name is {p}. A red plane crashed... There was a helmet, but no sign of the pilot.
{!R}The Eagle crashed!? Ryo is missing!? {!R}Is this the doing of this "black moon"...?
Did you say black moon!?
{!R}Those were Ryo's... Ryoma Nagare's last words. {!R}He shouted "A black moon's come out!" and then contact was lost.
A black moon... Um, who are you...?
{!R}I'm Saotome, a scientist who studies Getter Rays.

{!R}...{p}-kun! I'd like to speak with you directly! {!R}I'm heading there to recover the Eagle! {!R}Until then, sorry to ask, but would you look for Ryo? {!R}He's wearing a pilot suit. You'll know him right away.
Understood, Dr. Saotome!
...So you've recovered the Eagle. ...Dr. Saotome, we couldn't find Ryo-san...
Knowing that lad, I daresay he's alive somewhere. Now then, {p}, won't you come with me to the Saotome Lab?
The Saotome Lab?
I want to learn more about the black moon.
But {s}...
Worried about her, sick as she is? Bring her along. I'll have the lab's doctor examine her.
Really!?
No objections, I see.\n\nThen we'll leave for the Saotome Lab as soon as you're ready.
